hook: orphan 戰意團推沙盤：animus／enmity／inimical／feint——教官說「這是演練」，有人已經把紅旗插滿。
script: animus／enmity 敵意。inimical 敵對有害。feint 佯攻。martial 軍事的。munition 軍火。conflagration 大火（戰火意象）。口令：沙盤寫「演練」，紅旗寫「別真打」。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 紅旗: animus walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「紅旗」出場：animus 一上場梗就黏住——敵意。

members.senseAnchor: a state of deep-seated ill-will; the feeling of a hostile person
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 對立線: enmity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「對立線」出場：enmity 一上場梗就黏住——敵意。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 有害標: inimical walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「有害標」出場：inimical 一上場梗就黏住——敵對的。

members.senseAnchor: any distracting or deceptive maneuver (as a mock attack); deceive by a mock action
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 假動作: feint walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「假動作」出場：feint 一上場梗就黏住——佯攻。

members.senseAnchor: Roman poet noted for epigrams (first century BC); (of persons) befitting a warrior
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 迷彩: martial walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「迷彩」出場：martial 一上場梗就黏住——軍事的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 彈藥箱: munition walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「彈藥箱」出場：munition 一上場梗就黏住——軍火。

members.senseAnchor: a state of armed violent struggle between states, nations, or groups
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 火線: conflagration walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「火線」出場：conflagration 一上場梗就黏住——大火。

members.senseAnchor: a military trainee (as at a military academy)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 新生盔: cadet walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「新生盔」出場：cadet 一上場梗就黏住——軍校生。

members.senseAnchor: a minor short-term fight; engage in a skirmish
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 擦槍火: skirmish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「擦槍火」出場：skirmish 一上場梗就黏住——小衝突。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 包圍圈: besiege walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「包圍圈」出場：besiege 一上場梗就黏住——圍攻。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 集合哨: rally walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「集合哨」出場：rally 一上場梗就黏住——重整旗鼓。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 沙盤: sandtable walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「沙盤」出場：sandtable 一上場梗就黏住——沙盤。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。
